AlarmDescription: Fleet eval success rate IF(total > 0, (total - span_missing - errors) / total, 1) dropped below 0.8. Covers BOTH failure modes: span_missing (runtime telemetry broken — no invoke_agent span) AND error sessions, including judge throttling (ThrottlingException) and validation failures. Reads the dimensionless fleet-rollup series the eval-packager emits (TEAM-3386) — CloudWatch rejects alarms built on SEARCH() expressions, so per-agent SUM(SEARCH(...)) is not an option. A zero-total period (e.g. an all-duplicates delivery, which emits EvalSessionsTotal=0) is explicitly treated as healthy: the IF() guard pins the rate to 1, non-breaching for LessThanThreshold 0.8. Fires on 3 of 4 hourly datapoints. DEPLOYMENT ORDER (TEAM-3376/TEAM-3386): apply only AFTER (a) the runtime anchor-span fix is deployed to the fleet, (b) the eval-packager version that emits the dimensionless rollup (TEAM-3386) is deployed, and (c) at least one healthy batch with non-zero EvalSessionsTotal and the EvalSessionsError metric has been observed in CloudWatch — earlier, the rate computes over pre-fix data and fires immediately. INSUFFICIENT_DATA when no eval sessions arrive (quiet hours) — expected, do not page on it. Add AlarmActions (environment SNS topic ARN) at apply time.
